descriptions.zh:
自从我们意识到自己不是寰宇之中的孤独之身后，不受外交关系影响的实质星系贸易就一直存在着。随着星系的边境线被不断刷新，旧的商路也不断重绘，星际领袖们同意应该§Y使这种贸易市场合法化§!，让大家都可从中受益。

在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如果该贸易中心坐落于[Root.GetAdj]境内，一定会使我们受益，因此我们可以§Y宣传我们的一颗星球§!作为位置候选。
descriptions.en:
De facto galactic trade, unbound by the performance of international diplomacy, has existed since we first discovered that we are not alone in the universe. As new borders are discovered and old ones redrawn across the galaxy, galactic leaders agree that it is time to §Ylegitimize this commercial forum§! so that all may benefit.

In the coming years, independent traders and government agencies will be looking to establish a quasi-centralized hub for galactic commerce. We would surely benefit were this hub to fall within [Root.GetAdj] space, so we can choose to §Ypromote one of our worlds§! for this purpose.

descriptions.zh:
遗憾的是，我们一直未能有效地打击§Y与异种社会的违法贸易§!。同样令人遗憾的是，这一不受外交关系影响而且几乎匿名的贸易市场带来了实实在在的利润。

在今后的几年里，私营贸易者与政府机构将试图建立一个准星系贸易中心。如能主导此贸易中心的运营，想必一定会比囤积外星货物要有用得多，因此我们可以§Y宣传我们的一颗星球§!作为位置候选。
descriptions.en:
It is a regrettable fact that we have consistently failed to quash the illicit §Ytrade with the xenos§!. Equally regrettable is that the economic benefits of a largely anonymous forum for trade decoupled from international relations cannot be denied.

In the coming years, independent traders and government agencies will be looking to establish a quasi-centralized hub for galactic commerce. The economic gains from playing host to such a nexus might well outweigh the burden of harboring alien goods, so we can choose to §Ypromote one of our worlds§! for this purpose.

descriptions.zh:
星际消费者们，客户们还有各位乡巴佬们，终于准备好迎接一个准中心化的平台进行轻监管的、中等规模的国际贸易。

我们可以§Y提名一个我们的星球§!成为贸易枢纽，通过这种方式以获得最大化的潜在收入。
descriptions.en:
The customers, clients, and rubes of the galaxy at long last seem ready to accept a quasi-centralized platform for deregulated, mid-scale international commerce.

We can §Ypromote one of our worlds§! to play host to this commercial hub, to maximize potential revenue.

descriptions.zh:
很不幸，我们发起的建立泛星系贸易市场的动议§Y碰壁了§!。虽然我们明显成功地为该计划调动了政治意愿，但却没收到任何有效的主办地提名。

原则上，商业说客和政治拥趸都支持这个想法，并发誓会加倍努力，只要[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]希望再次尝试。
descriptions.en:
Our motion to bring forth a new Galactic Market has unfortunately §Yfailed§!. While we clearly succeeded in mustering the political will for such a scheme, it did not receive any valid nominations for a host site.

Commercial lobbyists and political proponents alike stand by the idea in principle, having vowed to redouble their efforts should the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] wish to try again.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
看来星系的市场范围无法承载其政治意图。苦于缺乏有效的主办地提名，最近 [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]为构建专门的交易中心而做出的努力都§Y白费了§!。

泛星系贸易市场计划的支持者们旋即表明一点都不觉得尴尬，声称只要[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]认为时机成熟，他们将再次提出自己的主张。
descriptions.en:
It would seem the galaxy's political will has exceeded the reach of its markets. Recent efforts by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] to establish a dedicated trading hub have §Yfailed§!, with no valid nominations for a host site.

Proponents of the Galactic Market scheme were quick to deny any hint of embarrassment, declaring that they will make their case again whenever the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] considers itself ready.

descriptions.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的市场范围无法承载其政治意图，因为最近他们为形成统一的泛星系贸易市场而做出的努力都§Y白费了§!。到头来，异种人备受推崇的项目连一个有效的主办地提名都没能吸引到。

计划的支持者否认这表明异星人的“合作”想法是弄巧成拙。相反，他们坚定地宣称，如果星系的成员认为时机成熟了，可以再次尝试。
descriptions.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s political will has exceeded the reach of its markets, as their recent effort to form a unified Galactic Market has §Yfailed§!. After all was said and done, the xenos' much-vaunted project couldn't entice a single valid nomination for a host site.

Proponents of the scheme have denied that this exposes the true folly behind ideas about xeno 'collaboration'. Instead they are resolute in claims that the galaxy may try again, when its members consider themselves ready.

descriptions.zh: 我们对[market_founder_planet.GetName]进行的推广宣传有了收获，而贸易巨头们决定将大部分商业活动集中在[market_founder_planet.GetStarName]星系内！
descriptions.en: Our marketing campaign on [market_founder_planet.GetName] has borne fruit, and the market-powers-that-be have seen fit to centralize much of their activity within the [market_founder_planet.GetStarName] system!

tooltips.zh: §H泛星系贸易市场空间站§!已成立于§Y[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]§!星系
tooltips.en: §HGalactic Market Station§! established in the §Y[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]§! system

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 泛星系贸易中心已被设立在§Y[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]§!恒星系，位于[From.GetName]境内。[From.GetAdj]政府已经正式宣布这一市场合法，资源已经可以通过中立第三方进行买卖。
descriptions.en: The center of galactic commerce has manifested in the §Y[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]§! system, within the borders of the [From.GetName]. The [From.GetAdj] administration has officially legitimized this marketplace, where resources can be bought and sold through unaffiliated third parties.

descriptions.zh: 心怀鬼胎的§Y[From.GetName]§!异种建立了一个外星商品的交易市场。尽管我们对此不屑一顾，但市场的大门仍对我们敞开。
descriptions.en: The dubious xenos of the §Y[From.GetName]§! have established a marketplace for the trade of alien goods. While we are naturally loath to take part in this exchange, the option is available to us.

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 在与其前中心失去联络之后，星系商贸团体选择在我们境内设立一座新的空间站。
descriptions.en: Following loss of contact with their former hub, the galactic merchant community has chosen to establish a new station within our borders.

tooltips.zh: §H泛星系贸易市场空间站§!已成立于§Y[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]§!星系
tooltips.en: §HGalactic Market Station§! established in the §Y[galactic_market_station.solar_system.GetName]§! system

descriptions.zh: 通过新的联系，我们已经获得了通过泛星系贸易市场进行资源买卖的权利。这一定会刺激[Root.GetAdj]经济。
descriptions.en: Through our newly-established contacts, we have gained access to a galactic marketplace for the purchase and sale of resources. This will surely be a great boon to the [Root.GetAdj] economy.

descriptions.zh: 我们得知恶心的异种们建立了一个交易外星商品的星系市场。尽管我们不愿涉足其中，但市场的大门仍对我们敞开。
descriptions.en: We have learned of a galactic marketplace for the trade of alien goods, established by the loathsome xenos. While we are naturally reluctant to take part in this exchange, the option is now available to us.

descriptions.zh: 确认
descriptions.en: OK

descriptions.zh: 最后一个[GetPreFTLLower]§H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!被从他们的母星[From.From.GetName]上被绑架作为奴隶。一些离散的幸存者可能还会在[From.From.GetPlanetMoon]的野外中徘徊，但是已经不足以维持任何形式的文明了。
descriptions.en: The last of the [GetPreFTLLower] §H[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! have been abducted into slavery from the surface of [From.From.GetName], their homeworld. A few scattered survivors might still be roaming the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]'s wilderness, but not enough to maintain any kind of civilization.

label.zh: 他们应该好好服侍我们。

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 我们向帝国屈服，我们别无选择了……
descriptions.en: We yield to the Imperium. You have left us little choice...

descriptions.zh: 只有愚者才会试图挑战星海帝国的意志。我们投降。
descriptions.en: Only a fool would stand up to the might of the Galactic Imperium. We surrender.

descriptions.zh: 我们……我们宣誓向[Root.GetRulerTitle]效忠，并保证作为忠诚的帝国子民服务星海帝国。
descriptions.en: We... we swear fealty to the [Root.GetRulerTitle], and pledge to serve the Galactic Imperium as loyal Imperial citizens.

descriptions.zh: 我们向[Root.GetRulerTitle]政权投降。
descriptions.en: We shall submit to the authority of the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

descriptions.zh: [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]欢迎你们加入星海帝国，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你现在已经成为了比[Root.GetName]更伟大事物的一部分。
descriptions.en: The [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] welcomes you to the Galactic Imperium, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You are now part of something far greater than the [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 星海帝国已经展现了他们的强大力量。认清事实，继续抵抗是徒劳的，拥抱你的未来成为帝国的子民吧。
descriptions.en: The Galactic Imperium has demonstrated its might. Accept the futility of continued resistance, and embrace your future as Imperial citizens.

descriptions.zh: 很好。一切都如同[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]所预见的那样进行着。
descriptions.en: Good. Everything is proceeding as the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has foreseen.

descriptions.zh: 暴政在今天胜利了，星系为此变得更加地黑暗。我们投降。
descriptions.en: Tyranny has prevailed this day, and the galaxy is a darker place for it. We surrender.

descriptions.zh: 你们帝制派或许赢得了这场战争，但帝国不会永存。自由之光迟早会重回星系！
descriptions.en: You Imperials may have won this war, but the Imperium cannot last forever. Freedom will be restored to the galaxy!

descriptions.zh: 求求你们……帝国赢了，叛乱结束了。我们只求获得宽大处理。
descriptions.en: Please... the Imperium has won. The rebellion is over. We ask only for mercy.

descriptions.zh: 是我们输了。帝国比我们预期的还要强大。
descriptions.en: We have failed. The Imperium was stronger than predicted.

descriptions.zh: 反叛的渣滓。这种背叛的行为不会被忘记的。
descriptions.en: Rebel scum. This act of treachery will not soon be forgotten.

descriptions.zh: 你们这群愚蠢的家伙胆敢违抗[From.GetRulerTitle]。现在你们都得付出代价了。
descriptions.en: You were fools to revolt against the [From.GetRulerTitle]. Now you have paid the price.

descriptions.zh:
帝国没有叛乱的立足之地。你最好给我记清楚这点。

[From.GetRulerTitle]万岁！
descriptions.en:
Sedition will never be tolerated within the Imperium. You would do well to remember that.

Long live the [From.GetRulerTitle]!

descriptions.zh: 对[From.GetRulerTitle]的反对是徒劳的。接受你是这一个更伟大整体一部分的角色吧。
descriptions.en: Future opposition to the [From.GetRulerTitle] is futile. Accept your role within the greater whole.

descriptions.zh: 星海帝国将会开启星系的一个黄金时代，而你们这些叛徒却弃之而去。那就随你们便吧，傻子们！
descriptions.en: The Galactic Imperium was the beginning of a golden age for the galaxy, and yet you traitors chose to throw it all away. Have it your way then, fools!

descriptions.zh: 够了！这个星系不配拥有我们打算创造的辉煌明天。就让帝国这么烧毁吧！让星系再次堕落到无政府和混乱的状态吧！
descriptions.en: Enough! This galaxy does not deserve the shining future we were building. Let the Imperium burn, then! Let the galaxy descend into anarchy and chaos once more!

descriptions.zh: 我们只是想为星系带来秩序和稳定，但也许混乱才是不可避免的宿命。你们赢了，叛军们！我们会让出帝位的。
descriptions.en: We wanted only to bring order and stability to the galaxy, but perhaps chaos is inevitable in the end. Victory is yours, rebels! We shall abdicate the throne.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle]会投降的。我们没能成功预测你们的真实背叛程度，如今星系必须为此付出代价。
descriptions.en: The [From.GetRulerTitle] will yield. We failed to predict the true depth of your treachery, and now the galaxy must pay the price.

descriptions.zh: 你们对星系的暴政到头了，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
descriptions.en: Your tyranny over the galaxy is at an end, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

descriptions.zh: 和星海帝国一起见鬼去吧！是时候复原星海共同体了！
descriptions.en: Down with the Imperium! It is time to bring back the old Galactic Community!

descriptions.zh: 就让你们的覆灭成为未来任何一个想要想星系内称王称霸的家伙们的教训吧。
descriptions.en: Let your downfall be a lesson to any future would-be tyrants who seek to rule the entire galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 你们可耻的社会构造——星海帝国——已经不复存在了。
descriptions.en: Your shameful social construct - the Galactic Imperium - is no more.

descriptions.zh: 拿好！你可悲的投降书已经被签好了字，所有的帝国军也被下令放下武器。现在我想一个人静静，为帝国和本该完成的事哀悼……
descriptions.en: There! Your wretched Articles of Surrender have been signed, and all Imperial forces have been ordered to lay down their arms. Now leave me in peace, as I mourn the Imperium and what could have been...

descriptions.zh: 记住我说的这句话……星海帝国的覆灭也将让我们在未来陷入万劫不复的境地。当全星系的威胁出现时，还有什么名义能让我们再度团结一致起来呢？
descriptions.en: Mark my words... the destruction of the Galactic Imperium has doomed us all. How else could we stand united under one banner against the horrors that threaten our galaxy?

descriptions.zh: 如果帝国的子民们能更加英勇地战斗，事情会到这个地步吗！你们全都是叛徒！
descriptions.en: If the citizens of the Imperium had fought harder, this would not have come to pass! Traitors all!

descriptions.zh: 我们为星系带来了秩序，而你，却因为你显而易见无知而恐惧地抨击它。你都做了些什么？
descriptions.en: We imposed order on a chaotic galaxy, and you, in your predictable ignorance, lashed out in fear. What have you done?

descriptions.en: The Orbital Bombardment of §H[From.GetName]§! has sparked our Council to discuss how we should respond in the hypothetical scenario of a surrender.
